BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:


SECTION 1. Title 17, of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-K in the area bounded by


       West Roscoe Street; a line 73.28 feet west of and parallel to North
       Keeler Avenue; the alley next south ofand parallel to West Roscoe
       Street; and a line 121.28 feet west of and parallel to North Keeler
       Aventie,

to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat. Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.



SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.
